systems.system: numérisation du registre civil (appel d'offres DGCT)
systems.owner: Direction générale des collectivités territoriales (DGCT), ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: international tender of April 2025, 194 million dirhams in five regional lots (bids due 29 May): over 38 million acts back to 1915 held in 1,821 offices in ten regions; 27 million paper acts never digitised to be numbered, keyed by hand and checked, and over 11 million existing digital acts to be audited and indexed; priority to births after 1950 and deaths after 2003

systems.system: base de données centralisée et système d'information unifié de l'état civil
systems.tiers: stated aim of the project: to link all civil-status offices and allow real-time data exchange between public institutions; not said to be in place

systems.country_label: déclarations électroniques préalables des naissances, des décès, des mariages et des divorces (décret 2.22.04)
systems.tiers: introduced in law by the 2023 decree applying Law 36.21; the article does not say who files them or whether they are in use

note: No fact: the article reports a back-capture tender (archive). The unified system linking offices is given as an aim, and the electronic pre-declarations as a legal provision of 2023, neither described as operating. Denominator stated: 1,821 offices in the ten regions the tender covers.
